title: OINK navigation JSON, schema version 1
description: The opt-in machine-readable navigation tree the NAVJSON home output publishes, one file per language. Hand-authored, versioned contract artifact -- unlike the generated site-params and front-matter schemas, this file is edited deliberately and only together with the templates and checker that own the format. Array order is the contract; weights are never serialized. Presentation-only sidebar rows (dividers) are omitted.

pageNode.description: A navigable page in this language. id is the in-language permalink path, stable across languages for correlation; url is absolute; markdown appears only when the page publishes a Markdown output.

linkNode.description: A navigation placeholder without page identity: kind external carries a manual_link URL as authored, kind link carries a resolved manual_link_relref target.
